class.name: Box3DSurfaceMaterialLibrary
class.description: [Box3DSurfaceMaterialLibrary] is loaded from the [code]physics/box3d/surface_material_library[/code] project setting and indexed by [Box3DPhysics].

method.name: allocate_material_id
method.description: Returns an unused material id, one past the highest id currently in the library. Ids are baked into shapes and recordings, so freed ids are never handed out again.

method.name: find_material
method.description: Returns the authored material named [param name], or [code]null[/code]. Unlike [method Box3DPhysics.get_material] this searches the raw array, so it also finds entries the registry rejected.

members.member: The authored surface material resources, in Physics tab order. This is the raw array; [method Box3DPhysics.get_materials] returns only the entries that passed registration. Names and ids are made unique on assignment: the first entry with a given name or id keeps it, and any later entry with a duplicate or empty name is renamed, while one with a duplicate or non-positive id is given a fresh id one past the highest in the array. Each fix is reported as a warning. An array that is already valid is stored unchanged.
